items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: And Duke said to me, "Say, man, when are you join my band and see the world?"

ctx.x: Well, the last time I heard Duke, I was playing at some park out here. And Duke said to me, "Say, man, when are you join my band and see the world?" I said, "I've already seen the world!" [LAUGHS] This was about three or four years ago. I was with The World's Greatest Jazz Band, and the Duke Ellington band was on the same bill.
Was that out in Long Island?
